facts.title: hazard report during routine operation on P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 17 February 2013 a hazard report was recorded on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
